::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 7th [1867]  
**Manuscript:** MS University of Iowa; MsL/Y56ma1
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)
Please be so kind as to direct on this letter.

I am taking the [Chaplet of Pearls](cmy_books/cmybook_69.qmd) to have a final reading by its greatest critics[^1]

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Perhaps [Mary Anne Dyson](people/person_464.qmd) (who is known to have encouraged CMY to make Eustacie less adult) and her [sister-in-law](people/person_462.qmd).
